# Adapty

> Adapty is a revenue management platform for mobile in-app purchases and subscriptions: SDKs for iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, and Unity, a no-code paywall builder, A/B testing, subscription analytics, and integrations with major analytics and attribution tools. Trusted by 30,000+ apps.

## Core

- [Homepage](https://adapty.io/): Product overview and positioning.
- [Pricing](https://adapty.io/pricing/): Free until $5K/month revenue, then 1% of monthly revenue.
- [Why Adapty](https://adapty.io/why-adapty/): Feature breakdown versus alternatives.
- [Schedule a demo](https://adapty.io/schedule-demo/): Book a walkthrough with the team.
- [Sign up](https://app.adapty.io/registration): Create an account.

## Products

- [Flow & Paywall Builder](https://adapty.io/flow-paywall-builder/): Build, test, and ship onboardings and paywalls without code or app releases.
- [Paywall Builder](https://adapty.io/paywall-builder/): No-code paywall design and deployment.
- [AI Paywall Generator](https://adapty.io/ai-paywall-generator/): Generate custom paywalls in seconds.
- [Autopilot](https://adapty.io/autopilot/): Automated paywall A/B testing and growth recommendations.
- [Refund Saver](https://adapty.io/refund-saver/): Automate refund handling to cut refund rates.
- [Adapty Mail](https://adapty.io/mail/): Lifecycle email generation, testing, and attribution.
- [Apple Ads Manager](https://adapty.io/apple-ads-manager/): Optimize and scale Apple Search Ads campaigns.
- [Finance](https://adapty.io/finance/): Revenue-based, non-dilutive financing for apps.
- [Reliability](https://adapty.io/reliability/): Hybrid infrastructure with offline mode and 4-layer caching.

## Reports and benchmarks

- [State of Apple Ads 2026](https://adapty.io/apple-ads-for-subscription-apps/): Apple Ads benchmarks across 90 countries and 59 sub-niches, from 8,000+ apps.
- [State of In-App Subscriptions 2026](https://adapty.io/state-of-in-app-subscriptions/): Subscription benchmarks from 16,000 apps and $3B in revenue.
- [Adapty Pricing Index](https://adapty.io/app-subscription-pricing-index/): Data-driven pricing benchmarks from $2B and 11,000 apps.

## Tools and calculators

- [Subscription Price Radar](https://adapty.io/subscription-price-radar/): Compare your pricing against competitors in 60+ countries.
- [Subscription Revenue Calculator](https://adapty.io/subscription-app-revenue-calculator/): Estimate app profit and growth potential.
- [LTV Prediction Model](https://adapty.io/ltv-prediction-model/): Template for revenue, ARPPU, ROAS, and LTV projections.
- [Refund Calculator](https://adapty.io/refund-saver/#calculator): Estimate potential refund reduction.
- [Apple Receipt Checker](https://adapty.io/apple-receipt-checker/): Validate iOS in-app purchase receipts.
- [Apple Fiscal Calendar](https://adapty.io/apple-fiscal-calendar/): Apple payment dates for financial planning.

## Content and community

- [Blog](https://adapty.io/blog/): Subscription growth, paywall CRO, and Apple Ads benchmarks.
- [Blog index for LLMs](https://adapty.io/blog/llms.txt): Every English post with a link to its Markdown version.
- [Blog RSS feed](https://adapty.io/blog/feed/): The latest English posts; each locale has its own at /<lang>/blog/feed/.
- [Authors](https://adapty.io/blog/author/): Editorial team profiles.
- [Newsletters](https://adapty.io/newsletters/): Monthly paywall teardown newsletter.
- [Partnerships](https://adapty.io/partnerships/): Certified partner program.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://adapty.io/docs/): SDK setup, integrations, and API reference.
- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://adapty.io/docs/llms.txt): Machine-readable documentation map.

## Company

- [Careers](https://adapty.io/careers/): Open roles and hiring.
- [Security and Compliance](https://adapty.io/security-and-compliance/): SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR-compliant.
- [Contact](https://adapty.io/contacts/): Support and inquiries.
- [FunnelFox](https://funnelfox.com/): Web-to-app funnel product.

## Sitemaps

- [Sitemap index](https://adapty.io/sitemap_index.xml)
- [Blog posts](https://adapty.io/post-sitemap.xml)
- [SDK](https://adapty.io/sdk-sitemap.xml)
- [Integrations](https://adapty.io/integration-sitemap.xml)
- [Reports](https://adapty.io/report-sitemap.xml)
- [Case studies](https://adapty.io/case-studie-sitemap.xml)
- [Glossary](https://adapty.io/glossary-sitemap.xml)

## Optional

- [Blog index for LLMs, Türkçe (tr)](https://adapty.io/tr/blog/llms.txt): Posts in Türkçe, each with a link to its Markdown version.

# Adapty

> Adapty is a revenue management platform for mobile in-app purchases and subscriptions: SDKs for iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, and Unity, a no-code paywall builder, A/B testing, subscription analytics, and integrations with major analytics and attribution tools. Trusted by 30,000+ apps.

## Core

- [Homepage](https://adapty.io/): Product overview and positioning.
- [Pricing](https://adapty.io/pricing/): Free until $5K/month revenue, then 1% of monthly revenue.
- [Why Adapty](https://adapty.io/why-adapty/): Feature breakdown versus alternatives.
- [Schedule a demo](https://adapty.io/schedule-demo/): Book a walkthrough with the team.
